events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's second solo album, 'Imagine', was released in the UK on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine impact
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago, John Lennon released his iconic 'Imagine' album. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Matthew Thomas Sumner, known as Sting, the legendary musician and frontman of The Police, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Sting
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Sting! From The Police to his incredible solo career, a true music icon.

events.title: The first iPod was released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple launched the device that changed how we listen to music. What was on your first playlist?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating over six decades of the world's most famous secret agent. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent and enduring legacy of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since its release, The Beatles' 'White Album' still captivates. What's your favourite track from this double LP masterpiece?

events.title: Freddie Mercury tribute
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Remembered
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost an icon. Remembering the extraordinary talent and unforgettable stage presence of Freddie Mercury.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' changed the game. A pivotal album that pushed creative boundaries.

events.title: John Lennon tribute
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who tragically passed away on this day in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon Remembered
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost a musical visionary. Remembering John Lennon and his enduring message.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we honour the incomparable artistry and innovation of David Bowie. Forever a star.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today. Celebrating the enduring legacy and undeniable impact of Elvis Presley.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and songwriter Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jimmy Page
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the guitar maestro, Jimmy Page! From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, a true rock legend.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer-songwriter Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod Stewart
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Rod Stewart! Still rocking after all these years.
